target: Normal(fit$best$theta, 0.20) prior; Binomial + log-normal likelihood; equilibrium as hard restriction (same as NPE)

budget_per_chain.hessian: evaluations counted and reported separately for arm C

arms.A_mean: cov = (2.38^2/d) cov(NPE); starts = NPE mean (all chains)  [control]
arms.A_disp: cov as A; starts = 3 random NPE draws + 1 overdispersed (mean +/- 3 NPE SD)
arms.A_tail: cov as A; starts = 4 NPE draws from the top 0.5% Mahalanobis distance, different directions
arms.B_pilot: pilot: 4 chains x 3,000 evals (prior-scaled cov, adapt from 500); main cov = (2.38^2/d) pilot cov; starts = pilot end states
arms.C_map: cov = inverse Hessian of -log posterior at fit$best$theta (numDeriv); starts = MAP
arms.D_prior: cov = 0.1^2 diag(prior variance) (production setting); starts = 4 random NPE draws
arms.dt_daily: short chains, dt = 1/365, cov as A, NPE mean starts

thinning_rule: largest thin keeping >= 90% of unthinned bulk and tail ESS on the reference chains; chosen thin = 10 (storage only; diagnostics use all draws)

thresholds.drift_note: each update adds 50 draws to a window of >= 5,000, so ~1% change is expected noise; 1e-3 also reported
thresholds.start_sensitivity: |mean_arm - mean_ref| <= 3 * sqrt(mcse_arm^2 + mcse_ref^2) for every parameter
thresholds.decision: best min(bulk ESS) per CPU-hour among arms passing all checks
